name: What happens if I miss a 1031 exchange deadline?

mainEntity.name: What happens if I miss a 1031 exchange deadline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Missing either the 45-day identification deadline or the 180-day exchange deadline will typically disqualify your transaction as a 1031 exchange. If disqualified, the deferred capital gains from the sale of your relinquished property become immediately taxable in the year of the sale. This can result in a significant tax liability. It is crucial to monitor these dates closely and work with experienced professionals to avoid common pitfalls. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution emphasizes proactive planning to help clients stay on track.
